verdict.rationale: Sentry's agent tracing captures production traces and lets users replay conversations and compare models, prompts, cost and performance across live LLM calls. The evidence shows no way to curate datasets from those traces or to run offline evaluations against them. Comparing production calls in a dashboard is an adjacent monitoring feature, not dataset curation or offline evals, so the axis applies but is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can curate datasets from production traces and run offline evaluations against them
